title: बीर तवील को कोई देश क्यों नहीं लेता? 🏜️
cover_text: बीर तवील ज़मीन को कोई देश *नहीं* चाहता

cover.prompt: A weathered blank grey stone boundary marker half-buried in red-gold desert sand, large in the lower two-thirds of the frame, endless empty dunes behind it, calm deep dark dusk sky across the top, dramatic low sunlight, sharp focus, close-up

source: Encyclopaedia Britannica; CIA World Factbook (Egypt-Sudan boundary); UK 1899 and 1902 boundary agreements

fact_check.weak: hard to absorb on one listen: the 1899 and 1902 lines and the swapped areas get confusing

hook_score.why: Direct 'you can be king' personal hook with a strong gap in 'but how?'. It is specific and visual, and the claim is real and true, so it is the strongest opening.
hook_score.was: ये ज़मीन किसी देश की नहीं, कोई लेता क्यों नहीं?
